aluminum-carports.name: Aluminum Carports
aluminum-carports.shortDescription: Durable, weather-resistant carports for residential driveways, parking lots, and commercial properties.
aluminum-carports.description: Our aluminum carports are engineered for long-term outdoor performance with 6063-T5 aluminum profiles, precision welding, and premium powder coating. Fully customizable in span, height, roof style, and color to match your project requirements.
features: Snow and wind load options available

faqs.question: Can you customize carport dimensions?
faqs.answer: Yes. We provide OEM customization for width, length, height, column spacing, and roof panel options based on your site drawings.

faqs.question: What is the typical lead time?
faqs.answer: Standard projects: 15–25 days after order confirmation. Large commercial orders may require 30–45 days.

aluminum-pergolas.name: Aluminum Pergolas & Gazebos
aluminum-pergolas.shortDescription: Elegant outdoor pergolas and gazebos for gardens, patios, poolsides, and hospitality venues.
aluminum-pergolas.description: Zhenlong aluminum pergolas combine architectural aesthetics with structural reliability. Available in fixed and louvered roof designs, ideal for outdoor living spaces that require shade, ventilation, and visual appeal.
features: Fixed or adjustable louver roof systems

faqs.question: Do you offer motorized louver pergolas?
faqs.answer: Yes. We can supply manual or motorized louver systems depending on project budget and specifications.

faqs.question: Can pergolas be shipped flat-packed?
faqs.answer: Yes. Our modular design supports flat-pack export to reduce shipping volume and cost.

aluminum-canopies.name: Aluminum Canopies & Awnings
aluminum-canopies.shortDescription: Architectural aluminum canopies for entrances, walkways, balconies, and commercial facades.
aluminum-canopies.description: We manufacture aluminum canopy systems that protect against sun and rain while enhancing building aesthetics. Suitable for residential balconies, shop entrances, and large commercial walkway covers.

faqs.question: Can you manufacture based on architectural drawings?
faqs.answer: Absolutely. Send us your drawings or site photos and our engineering team will provide manufacturing solutions.

aluminum-railings.name: Aluminum Railings & Fences
aluminum-railings.shortDescription: Decorative and structural aluminum railings, balustrades, and fence systems for residential and commercial use.
aluminum-railings.description: Our aluminum railing and fence systems offer a premium alternative to wrought iron with superior corrosion resistance and lower maintenance. Custom patterns, heights, and gate integration available.

faqs.question: Can railings and gates use the same design?
faqs.answer: Yes. We typically design railing and gate systems as a matched set for visual consistency.

aluminum-gates.name: Aluminum Gates
aluminum-gates.shortDescription: Custom aluminum driveway gates, pedestrian gates, and sliding gate systems with premium finishes.
aluminum-gates.description: Zhenlong aluminum gates are built for security, durability, and curb appeal. We support swing and sliding configurations with manual or automated operation compatibility.

faqs.question: Do you supply gate motors?
faqs.answer: We can supply gates compatible with third-party automation systems, or recommend motor specifications for your market.

how-to-choose-aluminum-carport.title: How to Choose the Right Aluminum Carport for Your Project
how-to-choose-aluminum-carport.excerpt: A practical guide to material selection, roof types, load requirements, and customization options for aluminum carports.
how-to-choose-aluminum-carport.content:
Aluminum carports are increasingly popular for residential and commercial properties due to their corrosion resistance, low maintenance, and design flexibility.

## Key Factors to Consider

**1. Aluminum Grade**
Look for 6063-T5 or equivalent structural aluminum profiles.

**2. Surface Treatment**
Powder coating is standard. For coastal environments, consider PVDF coating.

**3. Roof Panel Options**
Polycarbonate panels provide natural light. Aluminum panels offer a solid architectural look.

**4. Wind and Snow Load**
Always specify your local climate conditions.

## Why Work with a Factory Directly?

Factory-direct sourcing allows full customization of dimensions, colors, and packaging.

powder-coating-vs-anodizing.title: Powder Coating vs Anodizing for Outdoor Aluminum Products
powder-coating-vs-anodizing.excerpt: Compare two popular surface treatments for aluminum pergolas, railings, and carports in different climate conditions.
powder-coating-vs-anodizing.content:
Surface treatment is critical for the longevity of outdoor aluminum structures.

## Powder Coating

- Wide color range (RAL system)
- Thick protective film
- Cost-effective for large structures

## Anodizing

- Metallic appearance
- Excellent adhesion to aluminum
- Limited color options

## Recommendation

For export projects in varied climates, powder coating is typically preferred due to color flexibility and proven outdoor performance.

aluminum-pergola-oem-guide.title: OEM Aluminum Pergola Manufacturing: What Buyers Should Know
aluminum-pergola-oem-guide.excerpt: Essential checklist for importers and distributors sourcing custom aluminum pergolas from China factories.
aluminum-pergola-oem-guide.content:
Sourcing aluminum pergolas through OEM partnerships can significantly improve margins and product differentiation.

## Pre-Order Checklist

1. Request material certificates and coating test reports
2. Confirm engineering drawing approval process
3. Define packaging standards for export
4. Agree on inspection protocol before shipment
5. Clarify warranty terms for coating and structure

## Zhenlong OEM Process

We support full OEM/ODM from concept drawings to production, with sample prototyping available for qualified projects.
